Install the SDK with npm i @flown/sdk, the code is on github.com/flown/recorder.
The config goes in recordings.json, for example "outDir": "D:\\Recordings\\20241005".
Our NAS share is \\192.168.1.20\videos, so clips land there.
Ping me at dev.team@acme.dev if the script fails.

cards.text:
Automating Flown from the command line:

1. npm i @flown/sdk
2. Put your settings in recordings.json, e.g. "outDir": "D:\\Recordings\\20241005"
3. Point the output at your NAS: \\192.168.1.20\videos

Code: github.com/flown/recorder
Script your recordings: npm i @flown/sdk → edit recordings.json → done. Questions: dev.team@acme.dev

```json
{ "outDir": "D:\\Recordings\\20241005", "fps": 60 }
```

Clips are copied to `\\192.168.1.20\videos` when the export ends.
